title: Sum of Two Integers
summary: Add two integers without using the + or - operators.

tests.explain: 011 + 101: the bits carry all the way up and the result is 1000, which is 8.
Negative numbers are stored in two's complement, so the same loop gives -3.
-1 is all 1 bits. The carry ripples through every bit and falls off the top, leaving 0.

hints: Think about adding binary numbers by hand, one column at a time. Which operator gives the column's digit if you ignore the carry?
a ^ b adds every column without carrying. a & b marks the columns where both bits are 1, which is where a carry is produced; shifting it left by one moves each carry into the next column.
Repeat a, b = a ^ b, (a & b) << 1 until b (the carry) is 0. JavaScript's 32-bit bitwise operators make negative numbers work too.

complexity.time: O(1): at most 32 iterations, since the carry moves one bit left each time
